utterance: This account already keeps an S3 store in service for the `orders-team` database audit records, and an IAM role in service for delivering them. Define an AWS RDS option group named `option-group-pike` with major engine version 11, using the `sqlserver-ee` engine. It should have options for `SQLSERVER_AUDIT` and `TDE`. IAM_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET_ARN are included under the SQLSERVER_AUDIT option, naming the identity and the store this account keeps in service for those records.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: an RDS option group named option-group-pike exists for the sqlserver-ee engine at major engine version 11.00, carrying a TDE option and a SQLSERVER_AUDIT option whose IAM_ROLE_ARN setting names the identity the account keeps in service for delivering the orders-team database audit records and whose S3_BUCKET_ARN setting names the store, and the place under that store, the account keeps those records in
main.diff: the option group option-group-pike (sqlserver-ee 11.00, SQLSERVER_AUDIT with IAM_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET_ARN settings, TDE) plus the inline write permission the delivery role needs on the store; the store and the role themselves already exist
